title: Compensation planning review
notes: Synthetic planning case grounded in implemented compensation policy, template, and derived-fact substrate; the roadmap's broader compensation-planning workflow is planned.
reviewQuestions: Can a reviewer assess proposed compensation with base, bonus, benefits, and employer-tax context?
Does the design show uncertainty and policy assumptions instead of presenting a draft as payroll truth?
outcomes: A reviewer can identify out-of-band proposals and their cost drivers.
A reviewer can request changes or prepare a decision-ready compensation summary.
